site_permission_data_flow.message: For an authorized site, a source preflight may send page candidates to the local workbench. Video processing may read relevant cookies for the page and media-candidate hosts; those cookies go only to the local workbench, never to a model. Subtitle-only mode does not read cookies. If you choose a remote model, it may receive subtitles or frames for the selected task mode.
